rules.statement: Where there are several lands mortgaged, the plaintiff should be allowed to purchase any one of them at a price which bears the same relation to his aggregate claim as the appraised value of that land bears to the total appraised value of the lands.
rules.supporting_quote: The decree makes proper provision for the sale of all lands together, in which case the plaintiff cannot purchase these lands for less than the full amount of his claim and interest. Provision, however, has to be made as I said for the sale of these lands separately, and we direct that in such cases the plaintiff, if he desires to purchase any one of these lands, can only do so for a price which bears the same relation to the 390 whole of his aggregate claim as the appraised value of that land bears to the total appraised value of all the lands, and he will be entitled to credit for the amount of that purchase price.
